title: Taiwanese Senior Citizen Center 紐約台灣老人聯合會
content_html: The Taiwanese Senior Citizen Center, also known as the New York Taiwan Senior Center, serves the Taiwanese senior community in the greater New York area, particularly the Flushing, Queens region. It was formed through the merger of three longstanding Taiwanese senior organizations — the Taiwanese Christian Elders Association, the Changchun Association, and the Songbai Association — to consolidate resources and enable members to access U.S. government benefits for retirees, including daily nutritious lunches, medical care, and activity center programs. The center currently serves approximately 500 members and offers physical fitness activities, arts and leisure classes, social welfare referrals, and health seminars. Members have also formed a choir, a Taiwanese opera (歌仔戲) troupe, and dance groups that perform regularly in the community.
